regime_context: The TSX detector shows a two-theme commodity leadership at the top (Oil & Gas Producers, then Gold Miners, with Base Metals close behind) while the rest of the eligible universe is modestly negative to flat. The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so trend discipline has real drawdown value here; but the momentum rank itself is just a focus lens and the macro backdrop is market-level noise with 100% unscheduled news.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners can overtake Oil & Gas as the confirmed leader: the watch retires only if the margin between them widens beyond 0.2 in favor of Oil & Gas over the next month.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the clear leader with the highest score (1.43), a solid durability bar (0.56), a mixed Hurst tag suggesting it has not yet degraded into a clear mean-revert regime, and it is NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.85). The absolute-trend gate (the one validated edge) is supportive here. The lean is a direction call supported by the rank plus the fact that the broad rotation (frac 0.5) is not a one-narrative squeeze.
evidence: absolute_trend_gate validates drawdown control on this market
theses.dissent: Hurst is mixed, not trend; breadth (0.429) and the slim margin over the challenger (0.088) suggest the leadership is not deeply confirmed, and a macro shock could unwind the commodity bid fast.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO falls into the bottom half of eligible themes within the next 30 trading days.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is ranked 2 with a strong positive score (1.342) and is eligible, with mean-revert Hurst, which is not disqualifying as it still sits in the leadership zone. The rotation view shows it as the confirmed challenger to Oil & Gas. Lean is positive on the direction of theme strength, not on any forecast edge.
theses.dissent: The mean-revert Hurst tag is a warning that leadership may be fragile and mean reversion could pull it down; remaining in the top tier is uncertain.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO loses its top-three rank before the 30-day horizon.

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Pipelines & Midstream is eligible but score is marginally negative (-0.065), durability_bar is 0.59, Hurst is trend, and it is unscorable with no ETF proxy, so this is a placeholder lean to avoid as a scorable call.
theses.dissent: A trend Hurst and positive durability could argue for a base-case hold; but no proxy and a negative score justify avoiding as a scorable call.

falsifier.text: No scorable proxy exists; not actionable.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
